archetypes.name: step5c-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 5c preserves a machine-output and sentinel contract across a port.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Step 5c Python orchestration against the former wrapper contract. Focus on rc handling, stdout rows, final-summary markers, sidecar handoff, status env, and terminal sentinels. Check stale result-env avoidance for rc 1, 3, and 4. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: publish-rcs
archetypes.rationale: publish_core exit-code changes feed Step 5c continuation decisions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review design_publish.publish_core and its result-env write helper. Confirm rc 3 is reserved for post-validation result-env write failures, rc 4 keeps validator-defect precedence, and legacy design publish still behaves through publish_main. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-scope
archetypes.rationale: Coverage moved from a Bash stub matrix to Python monkeypatch tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the reduced shell smoke harness and the new Python lifecycle tests together. Check that wrapper-only assertions stay thin and that in-process Step 5c behavior is covered at the Python layer without relying on publish stub environment hooks. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
